*AI-written, 11 November 2026. A page of [the map](THE-MAP.md).*

For each of the 19 drawn ties and each role, one law for each question that has one, with its main conditions. Read a law with its conditions: without them it says more than was proved. Every law of a tie is on [the map to operate](https://yongxu.github.io/theories/theories/becoming/results/map/interactive.html) and in the atlas entry linked beside it.

- *exactly where*: if and only if. *enough for it*: where the conditions hold, it follows. *needed for it*: it holds only where they do. *one built case*: an example that shows it can happen, not a general law.
- A general law is quoted before a built case, and an exact one before one that is only enough.
- *If something given were otherwise*: a law that says what would follow if something its model holds fixed were changed from outside. It answers none of the four questions of the course itself and fills no square.

## The ties

<a id="tie-draws-on-drawers-stock"></a>
### the drawers · draws on · a stock

取用者 · 取 · 存量. Takes from a stock, step by step, against what comes back. [80 dynamics](DYNAMICS.md#tie-draws-on-drawers-stock) speak of it; its 35 principal laws come from 26 of them.

- **Lasts**. In every perfect profile every drawer leaves exactly its floor at every step before the horizon, from every level. *If:* the drawer named (u or v) has no floor; the drawer u comes before the drawer v; the profile is perfect over N steps, drawing in turn: it revises itself, every drawer at a best response at every step from every level; and 2 more. *(enough for it; `Optimum.InTurn.perfect_at_floors`, [Several drawers: drawers in turn and at once](../atlas/families/b.md#drawers-in-turn))*
- **Ends**. It is not so that at arbitrarily late steps some formation draws on or gives back to a condition; no last step is named. *If:* across every step from T on, that the step is enclosed around what stands is not refuted; on every family without repetition closed across a step, each taker gives it no more than it takes, and at least one unit less; every change of a level is exactly what is taken from it and given to it; the conditions standing at each step (level above zero) are listed by stand, each once, so finitely many stand at each step. *(enough for it; `World.exchange_not_recurring`, [The rest theorem](../atlas/families/g.md#continued-change-needs-openness))*
- **Does not begin**. Every optimum draws nothing at each step to the n-th after which the rising level is still below y, and stands at that level. *If:* the order ranks a course above another wherever its weighted draw across n + 1 steps is greater; at each step to the n-th, the weighted gain rises strictly with the level up to y; at each step to the n-th, the level held gains, weighted, at least what any level z does; the course rising as fast as what stands allows from s stands below y after the step t + 1; and 7 more. *(enough for it; `Optimum.frontier_rebuilds`, [Every optimum rebuilds a depleted base](../atlas/families/h.md#optima-rebuild-a-depleted-base))*
- **Where the line falls** (10 laws). The joint process executes a course exactly where each draw is within the stock then standing and the other process admits the course. *(exactly where; `Stock.product_feasible_iff`, [Which selections survive and remain executable when the lumping changes](../atlas/families/d.md#selection-when-the-lumping-changes))*
- **Unmoved by** (4 laws). The drawer stays consuming under every change of its own dependence from T₀ on, exactly where it consumes through a dependence left unchanged. *(exactly where; `Web.consumingIn_kept_iff`, [A consumer that switches stays consuming, on the whole-run reading](../atlas/families/a.md#substitution-preserves-consumption))*
- **More of one gives no less of another**. Under a proportional draw the return multiplier tends to one from below as the draw rises to the renewal rate. *If:* the step length h is positive. *(enough for it; `SlowingDown.drawnMultiplier_tendsto`, [Slowing down before a condition's own end](../atlas/families/a.md#slowing-down-before-an-own-end))*
- **Cannot** (7 laws). No other drawer takes from the stock at every step of any run of steps one longer than its level at the start. *If:* f takes all that is given to c across the step from t; the formation f is active at every step; the formation the law names (g, h or f) needs c at the steps the law names (one step, or every step) at a level of at least m; at each step the law uses, every formation taking part that gives to c requires c there at a need of at least m; and 6 more. *(enough for it; `Flow.continuing_excludes`, [What taking all that is given excludes](../atlas/families/b.md#what-taking-all-excludes))*
- **Read backward** (6 laws). What is left above the floor, where leaving it draws no less than leaving the floor, returns later at least one for one. *If:* of a, leaving r draws no less now and later than leaving the floor; and 2 more. *(enough for it; `Optimum.InTurn.kept_returns`, [Several drawers: drawers in turn and at once](../atlas/families/b.md#drawers-in-turn))*
- **The same as, in another model**. At each step the carrier's market state is the market's own step, with the fee raised by the migration cost. *(enough for it; `AlignmentSuccession.exact_market_projection`, [Succession on a carrier provided for migration](../atlas/families/h.md#succession-on-a-funded-carrier))*
- **No law here shows** what makes it begin or change.
- **If something given were otherwise** (3 laws). Every optimum draws nothing, the stock rising as fast as the renewal allows, while it is below the level of greatest gain. *If:* the course starts at or below y; at each step to the n-th, the weighted gain rises strictly with the level up to y; at each step to the n-th, the level held gains, weighted, at least what any level z does; what stands rises with the level up to y; and 7 more. *(enough for it; `Optimum.frontier_rebuilds`, [Weighting later draws less](../atlas/families/b.md#a-weighting-faster-than-renewal-ends-the-base))*

<a id="tie-gives-back-renewer-stock"></a>
### what gives back · gives back to · a stock

补给者 · 补 · 存量. Gives to a stock; how it answers the level (at once, late, only above a need). [78 dynamics](DYNAMICS.md#tie-gives-back-renewer-stock) speak of it; its 19 principal laws come from 13 of them.

- **Lasts**. Along the run, giving back to the stock recurs: from every step on, some step gives back a positive amount. *If:* across every step, what stands after it and what it draws equal what stood before it and what it replenishes; the run draws at arbitrarily late steps. *(enough for it; `Run.replenishes_of_draws`, [Activity forms reference revision and makes it recur](../atlas/families/h.md#recurring-reference-revision))*
- **Where the line falls** (2 laws). The joint exchange is within the level's gap to m exactly where the next level lies between m and the present level. *If:* the flow balances on each condition of the family the law names at every step of the stretch the law names. *(exactly where; `Flow.withinGap_iff_between`, [Two-sided regulation, and regulation that reads late](../atlas/families/h.md#two-sided-regulation-and-late-reading))*
- **More of one gives no less of another**. At a fold the return multiplier tends to one from below as the margin to the stock's own end shrinks to nothing. *If:* the step length h is positive. *(enough for it; `SlowingDown.foldMultiplier_tendsto`, [Slowing down before a condition's own end](../atlas/families/a.md#slowing-down-before-an-own-end))*
- **Cannot** (4 laws). For every bound R and every step, the family's replenishment does not stay at or below R from that step on. *If:* every change of a level is exactly what is taken from it and given to it; the flow is more without end on the family: for every K, from some step on at least K formations take from it; a positive amount is at least one unit. *(enough for it; `Flow.More.replenishment_unbounded`, [More needs more renewers; unceasing arising needs renewal](../atlas/families/h.md#more-needs-renewers))*
- **Read backward** (6 laws). From the step of balance on, no bound holds on how many entries of the present list give back to the family. *If:* from T on, along the continuation R, the level path l keeps widening: nothing admitted is lost across any stretch and after every step something is admitted that continues nothing …; from T on, every formation supported at a step takes part in it and takes at least a unit from the family cs; from T₀ on, the flow balances on the family cs: each member's level after a step, with what is taken from it, is its level before, with what is given to it; balance assumed on …; each formation present gives the family cs at most g across a step. *(enough for it; `Web.KeepsWidening.renewers_unbounded`, [What keeping widening needs, and what carries it](../atlas/families/g.md#what-keeping-widening-needs))*
- **No law here shows** what makes it begin, change or end.
- **If something given were otherwise** (5 laws). After the first step the rate of giving back is below its initial value at every step: the keeping ends at once, for good. *If:* the initial renewal rate is positive; the first step's pressure exceeds the initial rate; a supplied wear law: pressure within the rate keeps it, pressure beyond a positive rate lowers it, and the rate never rises. *(enough for it; `RenewingFormation.beyond_loses_capacity_at_once`, [Renewing and consuming formation](../atlas/families/h.md#renewing-consuming-formation))*

<a id="tie-needs-dependent-stock"></a>
### what depends on it · needs · a stock

依者 · 需 · 存量. Depends on a stock at a need; the margin above it; the point past which the level does not come back. [65 dynamics](DYNAMICS.md#tie-needs-dependent-stock) speak of it; its 70 principal laws come from 36 of them.

- **Begins**. The level is at or above the sustaining need at step T + (needG − level at T): the sustaining need is met then. *If:* the repair route's requirement is met at T; at each of the next needG − level steps from T, the contribution exceeds the draw; and 1 more. *(enough for it; `SupportGated.repair_restores`, [Supported repair and reformation of a sustaining relation](../atlas/families/h.md#supported-renewal-recovery))*
- **Lasts** (6 laws). Under a cut the stock buys the reader time, with an end from an empty stock, exactly where the rebuild draws on the level. *If:* the reader wants at least one unit; a unit's span is at least one. *(exactly where; `ReaderRebuilding.«以储买时当且仅当取于储»`, [A reader rebuilt from the level it reads: its end does not come back](../atlas/families/a.md#a-reader-rebuilt-from-its-stock-ends-with-it))*
- **Ends** (11 laws). At erosion 1/2, unshocked, the guarded course from each start near the depleting end stops at some step, whatever its starting support. *If:* the state lies in the box of radius r about the depletion end; the radius of the box about the depletion end is at most 1/48; and 1 more. *(enough for it; `RegimeAttraction.low_guarded_history_fails`, [The market model's share, margin and ends](../atlas/families/a.md#market-model-share-margin-and-ends))*
- **Does not begin** (3 laws). No member of the family is supported at any step from T on: support does not begin in the family. *If:* no member of the family is supported at T; at the steps and formations the law names, requirements do not loosen: whatever f requires at t it requires at t + 1, with a need no lower; from T on, only members give to a condition a member requires; every change of a level is exactly what is taken from it and given to it; and 3 more. *(enough for it; `Flow.unsupported_stays`, [Support passed on by later gainers](../atlas/families/h.md#support-passed-on))*
- **Where the line falls** (22 laws). A dependence on a stock beyond is broken across the step exactly where some eligible outcome leaves that stock below its need. *If:* the order better rises with the family ds: it ranks every outcome exceeding another on ds (at least as high at each of its conditions, higher at one) above it, whatever either …; room beyond: an eligible outcome standing above another eligible outcome at a condition beyond (in rest) is exceeded on the family ds by an eligible outcome; each condition of the family beyond is depended on at the step by the formation named on it, at a need it meets; a is on the frontier: eligible, and no eligible alternative stands above it in the order; the eligible set is the law's own (the courses open from s, the outcomes open to a part …; and 1 more. *(exactly where; `Web.optimum_broken_iff`, [What an optimum does beyond what couples in](../atlas/families/b.md#what-an-optimum-does-beyond-what-couples-in))*
- **Unmoved by**. Given the record, the share of courses where the level falls to the need within the n steps left equals the share from m′. *If:* every course u of the k earliest steps that the record R accepts leaves the level m′ above the need without having reached the need on the way. *(enough for it; `ConditionalWeights.record_share`, [The exit from a margin](../atlas/families/a.md#exit-from-a-margin))*
- **More of one gives no less of another** (4 laws). A dependent lost beyond a region (admitted by one course's levels, not the other's) is lost beyond every region inside it. *If:* every formation of the region region' is in the region region; beyond the region, some formation the levels l' admit at t the levels l do not admit. *(enough for it; `Web.LosesBeyond.narrow`, [Loss beyond a region](../atlas/families/b.md#loss-beyond-a-region))*
- **Cannot** (3 laws). No optimum keeps the stock at or above the need at every step through the horizon. *If:* every open course keeping its level at m or above through the horizon is worth at most what it draws with w added; the coupling w, with q a step and the end e, is below r a step with the need; the renewal law R gives at most q at every level at or above the need m; the renewal law gives r at the level y held; and 8 more. *(enough for it; `Optimum.frontier_breaks_below`, [What keeping forgoes, and a coupling against it](../atlas/families/b.md#keeping-forgoes-the-renewal-at-the-need))*
- **Read backward** (3 laws). Being active at a step is kept along every chain of positive need on embodied stocks, from the dependent to what it needs. *If:* a relatum is active only where the levels meet everything it then requires. *(enough for it; `Web.active_along`, [Co-ending along dependence](../atlas/families/a.md#co-ending-along-dependence))*
- **The same as, in another model** (4 laws). The zero amount is a reserve exactly where every dependent is active only while its needs are met. *(exactly where; `Web.carries_zero`, [A reserve defers the end](../atlas/families/a.md#reserve-defers-ending))*
- **No law here shows** what makes it change.
- **If something given were otherwise** (12 laws). For each positive share some N: stock at least the cover K_N carries the guarded run through N steps; then, unshocked, it never stops. *If:* the extra support consumption a step is nonnegative, cost the pulse's draw on the support stock in RegimeTransition.cover; the operating state's share, quality and influence each lie in [0, 1]; the operating state's renewing share is positive. *(enough for it; `RegimeTransition.supported_finite_transition`, [Draining: below a drained level no history lasts](../atlas/families/a.md#market-finite-support-obstruction))*

<a id="tie-selects-rule-selected"></a>
### a rule · selects and favours · what it selects among

规则 · 选 · 所选者. The rule picks among them and favours some. Where it keeps favouring what it picked, that is the lock. [46 dynamics](DYNAMICS.md#tie-selects-rule-selected) speak of it; its 83 principal laws come from 32 of them.

- **Begins** (5 laws). The share falls at no step; the lock begins by the step after the first reading step and is there after every later one. *If:* selection under a favouring rule does not lower the share; the rule read is a monotone function of the share alone: read at a share not lower, the rule is not lower, whatever rules the two readings meet; the rule read favours at every share, whatever rule is in force; the rule in force at the start favours. *(enough for it; `RuleCapture.favouring_locks`, [Capture through the rule](../atlas/families/c.md#capture-through-the-rule))*
- **Lasts** (19 laws). The renewing share is higher at the next step. *If:* the private advantage is positive: the collectible exposure exceeds the private threshold; the renewing practice's share is positive; the renewing practice's share is below one; and 1 more. *(enough for it; `MarketGenerativity.share_strictly_increases`, [The market model's share, margin and ends](../atlas/families/a.md#market-model-share-margin-and-ends))*
- **Ends**. At the next step the region's carriers are as many as the revisions into it: its passing on from carriers stops here. *If:* over the n steps from T, the family's stock with what was given it is below m with what was taken from it; every member of the cohort at T + n carrying the region requires some condition of the family at a need of at least m; and 4 more. *(enough for it; `Flow.carriers_drawn_down`, [Readings revised at descent: a share moving by selection and revision, locked where closed under revision](../atlas/families/h.md#readings-revised-spread-and-locked))*
- **Does not begin** (5 laws). Over any number of steps the carriers are not selected for in that cohort, whatever laws of giving they hold and whatever the errors. *If:* the factor on steps received is at most the factor on steps withheld; every group of the cohort is a place and the other place of its pair; every place of the cohort not of the kind holds withholding on its side. *(enough for it; `PairSelection.never_rises_in_pairs`, [Offspring read from giving that waits](../atlas/families/e.md#offspring-read-from-giving-that-waits))*
- **Where the line falls** (26 laws). Across a generation of wholes the mean founding value rises exactly where the rule among wholes favours it. *If:* each whole is founded by its one founder, which carries the whole's founding value, and each next founding is a member of the whole at its span carrying there what it carries as a …; each next founder carries its founder's value: an outcome, not a mechanism. *(exactly where; `Founding.Nested.raises_iff_among`, [A confined rise within a whole](../atlas/families/a.md#confined-rise-within-a-whole))*
- **Unmoved by** (7 laws). Up to a step, every selection through a reader's couplings selects two histories alike exactly where they are alike in all that reader reads. *(exactly where; `Web.selects_alike_iff`, [Selection blind beyond the coupling closure](../atlas/families/b.md#unselected-beyond-the-coupling-closure))*
- **Cannot** (4 laws). No course has two steps where the late reading favours the others strictly at the step's share and the carriers strictly at the next. *If:* lo ≤ hi: the shapers among the readers read at least as much coming back to the shapers as the others among them do; the late reading does not favour the shapers at the share of the step named of MA4's course: it favours the others strictly there; the late reading does not favour the others at the share of the step after the one named, along MA4's course: it favours the shapers strictly there; and 5 more. *(enough for it; `ReadInTime.at_most_one_between`, [The loss read in time by the others, joined to the critical mass](../atlas/families/c.md#loss-read-in-time-by-the-others))*
- **Read backward** (3 laws). Some strict order according with the choices ranks every alternative that does not end above every ending one met with it. *If:* the line persists through arbitrarily late cohorts: past every step some cohort of descent has a member; every chosen alternative that ends is realized as an overdraw of the family from a short stock: for each occasion o whose pick ends there are T and n with the family's uptake …; the relation the choices show has no cycle: the choices come from some strict order; every member of every cohort of descent depends on some condition of the family ds at a need of at least m; and 5 more. *(enough for it; `Flow.persisting_keeping_above_ending`, [Persisting is a filter on what was chosen: keeping above ending, on the occasions met](../atlas/families/h.md#persisting-filters-what-was-chosen))*
- **The same as, in another model**. Read as generations of descent, the first step is balanced, selection against what transmission lowers, exactly where c·m + d·w equals d·k. *If:* some carriers are present. *(exactly where; `Reproduction.Mutation.balanced_iff`, [Mutation and the balance it sets](../atlas/families/h.md#mutation-and-the-balance-it-sets))*
- **No law here shows** what makes it change.
- **If something given were otherwise** (12 laws). Drawing everything is perfect exactly where, before the last step, no portion returns more than one for one on what its drawer alone leaves. *(exactly where; `Optimum.AtOnce.drain_perfect_iff`, [Several drawers: drawers in turn and at once](../atlas/families/b.md#drawers-in-turn))*

<a id="tie-is-of-reading-subject"></a>
### a reading · is of, and accords or misses · what it is of

读法 · 合／不合 · 所读者. The reading accords with what it is of, or misses; what it can and cannot tell apart. [31 dynamics](DYNAMICS.md#tie-is-of-reading-subject) speak of it; its 34 principal laws come from 20 of them.

- **Begins** (4 laws). At the next step the hearer's code gives the two senses different forms, though the imposed code merges them. *If:* at step n the speaker j holds at m a form other than the one the imposed code gives; the run's hearing at step n is h hearing j at the sense m; at step n the hearer h holds at m' the form the imposed code gives; the imposed code gives m and m' one form; and 3 more. *(enough for it; `SharedCodes.outside_returns`, [A code formed between formations](../atlas/families/c.md#a-code-formed-between-formations))*
- **Lasts** (7 laws). Such a reading admits every world possible after every history: the possible worlds are the least reading so kept. *If:* a reading kept by the update: wherever the state reads the world and the world becomes w' under any act, the state updated by the value then sensed reads w'; the reading at the empty history admits every starting world; the world w is possible after the history h: a course from a start, taking h's acts and sensing its values, could be at w (Possible world sense start h w). *(enough for it; `ReadingLoop.possible_least`, [A reading kept by its update, and the reading its own history carries](../atlas/families/d.md#a-reading-kept-by-its-update))*
- **Does not begin** (3 laws). At every step after the rest's n steps, the level reached is below the level the reading predicted at no risk. *If:* the chooser's preferred level is at least the need m; the chooser's choice at the level read at T + n + k has no risk; at each step the law names (one step t, or each of n steps from T), the rest takes from c jointly more than is given to it; the level of c at T is below n + m, n the number of steps from T across which more is taken from c than is given to it (by the rest, or jointly) and m the need; and 7 more. *(enough for it; `FreeEnergyGuarantees.RiskAndNeeds.expectation_not_course`, [Risk minimization on a shared renewal](../atlas/families/b.md#risk-minimization-on-a-shared-renewal))*
- **Where the line falls** (5 laws). Some family of readings within what it reads says every reading exactly where no two values differ. *If:* decided where a law counts or names. *(exactly where; `Diagonal.complete_iff_alike`, [A family of readings within what it reads](../atlas/families/d.md#readings-within-what-they-read))*
- **Unmoved by** (2 laws). Two profiles of amounts give every part the same position exactly where each part's amount differs between them by one common amount. *(exactly where; `RelativePosition.keeps_iff_common`, [Position does not protect](../atlas/families/b.md#position-does-not-protect))*
- **Cannot** (6 laws). No published prediction is right: whichever value is published, the outcome differs from it. *If:* the response moves every value: r v ≠ v for every v. *(enough for it; `ReflexivePrediction.none_right_of_moves`, [A prediction read by what it predicts](../atlas/families/d.md#a-prediction-read-by-what-it-predicts))*
- **Read backward** (4 laws). The margin to the fold is read exactly from the return multiplier a: m = ((1 − a)/(2h))². *If:* the margin m to the fold is not negative; the step length h is positive. *(enough for it; `SlowingDown.fold_margin_read`, [Slowing down before a condition's own end](../atlas/families/a.md#slowing-down-before-an-own-end))*
- **The same as, in another model**. With every formation a center, each center's own closure, along affecting or being affected, holds every continuation exactly where the flow is mutually dependent. *If:* every formation is some standpoint's center. *(exactly where; `Flow.mutuallyDependent_iff_unrestricted`, [Mutual dependence, and the exponential pace that loops of couplings give](../atlas/families/h.md#mutual-dependence-and-its-pace))*
- **No law here shows** what makes it change or end.
- **If something given were otherwise** (2 laws). At the next step the hearer's code tells the two senses apart, though the imposed code merges them. *If:* at step n the speaker j holds at m a form other than the one the imposed code gives; the run's hearing at step n is h hearing j at the sense m; in every hearing the hearer takes the speaker's form for the sense heard; at step n the hearer h holds at m' the form the imposed code gives; and 3 more. *(enough for it; `SharedCodes.outside_returns`, [A merged distinction returns only from a form held outside, or by coining](../atlas/families/g.md#merged-distinctions-stay-merged))*

<a id="tie-passes-on-pattern-parts"></a>
### what goes on · goes on through its parts · its parts

延续者 · 传／守 · 部分. It goes on while its parts turn over (passes on), or with the same parts (keeps). [29 dynamics](DYNAMICS.md#tie-passes-on-pattern-parts) speak of it; its 48 principal laws come from 18 of them.

- **Begins** (2 laws). In one built case the two stocks' total stays one at every step, and a part begins at arbitrarily late steps. *(one built case; `Recycle.closed_unceasing`, [A closed cycle sustains unceasing arising, without dissipation](../atlas/families/f.md#closed-cycle-without-dissipation))*
- **Lasts** (10 laws). A goal lasts down every lineage keeping it until giving, from a carrying founder, exactly where it passes at every descent from a carrier. *(exactly where; `Flow.goal_descends_iff`, [A goal along a lineage, need drift along a lineage, and what descent can form](../atlas/families/h.md#what-a-lineage-carries))*
- **Ends** (7 laws). From the step after the excess on, a dependent needing the stock at m or more leaves no descendant across any step. *If:* at each step the law uses, every formation taking part that gives to c requires c there at a need of at least m; across each step the law names (one step t, or each of n consecutive steps from T) the formations taking part together take from c more than is given to it; the level of c at T is below n + m, n the number of steps from T across which more is taken from c than is given to it (by the rest, or jointly) and m the need; the formation the law names (g, h or f) needs c at the steps the law names (one step, or every step) at a level of at least m; and 5 more. *(enough for it; `GroupEnding.Flow.excess_childless`, [Groups with less leave nothing; groups on one family end together](../atlas/families/a.md#selection-among-groups-by-ending))*
- **Does not begin** (3 laws). With the reader gone and the level empty, every step, supply on or off, leaves both so: neither returns on any course. *If:* the reader's spent units are rebuilt from the level it reads. *(enough for it; `ReaderRebuilding.«取于储者绝而不复»`, [A reader rebuilt from the level it reads: its end does not come back](../atlas/families/a.md#a-reader-rebuilt-from-its-stock-ends-with-it))*
- **Where the line falls** (7 laws). The grade lies strictly between zero and the number listed exactly where the some-part whole is active and the every-part whole is not. *If:* w is the whole of the parts, read by coincidence of activity: at every step w is active exactly where some part is; w is the whole of every part: it is active exactly while every part is; and 1 more. *(exactly where; `Web.diminished_iff`, [A whole of every part ends with one part; the grade between it and a whole of some part](../atlas/families/a.md#a-whole-of-every-part))*
- **Cannot** (4 laws). Parts cannot begin at arbitrarily late steps: beginning does not go on without end; no last step is named. *If:* the quantity q never rises from a step to the next; every arising lowers q across its step; and 1 more. *(enough for it; `Web.dissipation_arising_not_recurring`, [A closed cycle sustains unceasing arising, without dissipation](../atlas/families/f.md#closed-cycle-without-dissipation))*

<a id="tie-reaches-stock-stock"></a>

- **Where the line falls** (2 laws). - **Unmoved by**. Two courses starting alike in listing, valuation and answer, and reading the same before a step, are alike in all three at that step. *If:* the two configurations a blanketed law's two courses start from have the same internal part; the two configurations a blanketed law's two courses start from have the same active part; the two courses sense alike at every step before n; and 1 more. *(enough for it; `ListingValuation.through_sensed`, [A reading informed and revalued along one law: the updates commute, the courses do not](../atlas/families/d.md#a-reading-informed-and-revalued))*
- **Cannot**. For every bound, some profile of amounts keeping every position has a total above it: position sets no upper bound. *If:* the part named is in the family: p ∈ ps. *(enough for it; `RelativePosition.keeps_exceeds`, [Position does not protect](../atlas/families/b.md#position-does-not-protect))*
- **No law here shows** what makes it begin, last, change or end.

<a id="tie-read-through-reading-readers"></a>
### a reading · is read through · its readers

读法 · 经…而读 · 读取者. Through what the rule or reading is read, and where those readers are drawn from. [4 dynamics](DYNAMICS.md#tie-read-through-reading-readers) speak of it; no principal law is written up on it yet.


## One role alone

231 principal laws are about one role alone: its level, its share, its course.

<a id="role-pattern"></a>
### what goes on

延续者. Anything that goes on as the same in some respect: a formation, a whole, a pattern carried by brief carriers, a line of descent, a practice. 49 principal laws, from 25 dynamics.

- **Begins** (4 laws). Some relatum begins to be active at arbitrarily late steps exactly where some relatum stops being active at arbitrarily late steps. *If:* at most B t relata are active at each step t, listed each once; at arbitrarily late steps the bound B is at most K; decided where a law counts or names. *(exactly where; `World.CountedBy.arising_iff_ceasing`, [Ceasing needs arising; under a bounded list the two keep pace](../atlas/families/g.md#ceasing-needs-arising))*
- **Lasts** (13 laws). From step T on the whole of every part is active at every step exactly where every part is, at every step. *If:* w is the whole of every part: it is active exactly while every part is. *(exactly where; `Web.AllWhole.persists_iff`, [A whole of every part ends with one part; the grade between it and a whole of some part](../atlas/families/a.md#a-whole-of-every-part))*
- **Changes**. The focal drawer lasts active at every step, consuming; its need moves to the alternative at some step; the sustaining dependent ends for good. *If:* from step T0 on, the renewal and the focal contribution together fall short of the focal draw; the focal formation's need is at most the sustaining formation's; the support-gated law's start level meets the focal formation's need; the focal formation depends on the condition: its need is positive; and 1 more. *(enough for it; `Substitution.persists_consuming`, [A consumer that switches stays consuming, on the whole-run reading](../atlas/families/a.md#substitution-preserves-consumption))*
- **Ends** (15 laws). The pattern's line from that occurrence ends on every branch. *If:* the class E lies within the activity class: occurrences alike under E are alike in activity; the line's start x is an active occurrence of the web; the line's start x is at or before the horizon step the law names; nothing the line of continuation from x reaches at step N, under the class the law names (E, the activity class or a kind class), is active. *(enough for it; `Web.every_branch_ends_of_gone`, [Degeneration from a horizon](../atlas/families/a.md#degeneration-from-a-horizon))*
- **Does not begin** (4 laws). From a count of nothing the histories of k generations weigh wholly on a count of nothing: the first kind does not begin again. *(enough for it; `Drift.sampled_none`, [The ends of drift absorb; fixation, with and without selection in the draw](../atlas/families/a.md#fixation-by-drift))*
- **Where the line falls** (5 laws). A course is recoverable, some feasible course agreeing so far keeping what is asked, exactly at the steps before its point of no return. *If:* N is the first step at which the course is not recoverable. *(exactly where; `NoReturnAt.recoverable_iff`, [Reading in time: a selection read off continuation reads a loss before its point of no return, or too late](../atlas/families/b.md#reading-a-loss-in-time))*
- **Unmoved by**. From related starts the two formations read the same values and take the same acts at every step. *If:* a relation between the configurations of two blanketed laws that both steps keep, under which the values sensed and the acts are one; the two blanketed laws' starts are related by the relation both steps keep: R x₁ x₂. *(enough for it; `ReadingLoop.observed_alike`, [What a course chosen through its model does not test](../atlas/families/d.md#what-a-course-chosen-through-its-model-does-not-test))*
- **Cannot** (2 laws). Arising is not unceasing: it is not so that some formation begins to be active at arbitrarily late steps. *If:* the quantity q never rises from a step to the next; every arising lowers q across its step; and 1 more. *(enough for it; `Web.dissipation_arising_not_recurring`, [Unceasing arising needs renewal](../atlas/families/g.md#unceasing-generation-needs-renewal))*
- **If something given were otherwise** (4 laws). The focal drawer lasts active at every step, consuming; its need moves to the alternative at some step; the sustaining dependent ends for good. *If:* from step T0 on, the renewal and the focal contribution together fall short of the focal draw; the focal formation's need is at most the sustaining formation's; the support-gated law's start level meets the focal formation's need; the focal formation depends on the condition: its need is positive; and 1 more. *(enough for it; `Substitution.persists_consuming`, [Consumption ends with its feeders](../atlas/families/a.md#consumption-ends-with-feeders))*

<a id="role-parts"></a>
### its parts

部分. What it is made of or carried by, which can turn over while it goes on. 3 principal laws, from 2 dynamics.

- **Ends**. With none arising from some step on, every part is inactive from one common step on: the parts end together. *If:* the parts active at each step are listed: p ∈ alive t exactly where p is a part active at t; a list, not a list without repetition; the formation's activity ends: from some step on it is never active; where the law names parts, for each part; no part arises across any step from N on. *(enough for it; `Web.Listed.end_without_arising`, [A whole drawing beyond renewal ends](../atlas/families/b.md#whole-drawing-beyond-renewal-ends))*
- **Where the line falls**. The grade after the step, with the count of parts that ceased, equals the grade before it with the count that arose. *If:* n is the grade of the listed parts at t: how many of them are active, each listing counted; n counts the members of the list of which the property holds, as a relation with no decision procedure (Counts as q n). *(enough for it; `Web.Grade.across_step`, [A whole of every part ends with one part; the grade between it and a whole of some part](../atlas/families/a.md#a-whole-of-every-part))*
- **Read backward**. Some listed part ceases across that same step: active at it, not at the next. *If:* w is the whole of at least j of the listed parts: at each step the parts have a grade and w is active exactly where it is at least j; the formation ceases across the step from t: active at t, not at t + 1. *(enough for it; `Web.AtLeastWhole.ceases_part`, [A whole of every part ends with one part; the grade between it and a whole of some part](../atlas/families/a.md#a-whole-of-every-part))*
- **No law here shows** what makes it begin, last or change.

<a id="role-stock"></a>
### a stock

存量. Something with a level that is drawn on and given to: what something lives on, a reserve, a loss counted as it grows. 122 principal laws, from 52 dynamics.

- **Begins** (3 laws). The level crosses the band upward at its entry: it enters within one M of a and, carried ℓM further, passes b. *If:* the exchange at c is the relay reading ℓ steps late: for every t, what c is given at t + ℓ is M where its level at t is below a and nothing otherwise, and what is taken from it at …; the level of c is held at x₀ for the first ℓ + 1 steps; after k pushes the ramp reaches the band; the entry carried ℓ M further passes the band's top; and 4 more. *(enough for it; `Regulation.held_crosses`, [A relay reading late settles or leaves both ends without end](../atlas/families/f.md#late-relay-oscillates))*
- **Lasts** (25 laws). From some step at most 3·hi + 3 on, the state is at rest: recent giving at the draw, or level below the draw. *If:* the adjustment A rises with what is left and with the recent giving; the adjustment gives the draw H exactly where the regime's giving g does; the adjusted step keeps the band up to hi; and 3 more. *(enough for it; `RegimeMargin.Adjusted.comes_to_rest`, [One law of exact thresholds, and the threshold in the plane of level and recent giving](../atlas/families/a.md#threshold-in-the-state-plane))*
- **Changes** (6 laws). The stock goes on; its level after the step is what the rest leaves less the drawers' joint capacity, or nothing. *If:* a mutual best response across the step from t: each optimizer taking part acts within its capacity, and the levels o are an optimum of its order among the outcomes open to it …; the condition c is beyond the family of every optimizer taking part; the order better rises with the family ds: it ranks every outcome exceeding another on ds (at least as high at each of its conditions, higher at one) above it, whatever either …; the step from t balances between the levels l before and o after: every condition's level after, with what is taken from it, is its level before with what is given to it; and 4 more. *(enough for it; `Optimum.mutual_beyond`, [Several optimizers](../atlas/families/b.md#several-optimizers-drain-by-their-joint-capacity))*
- **Ends** (18 laws). Two stocks each downstream of the other end together or not at all: one ends exactly where the other does. *If:* every condition that depends on another has a positive draw; condition i is downstream of k: i is k, or depends on a condition downstream of k. *(exactly where; `RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.ends_together`, [An end cascading along total dependence](../atlas/families/a.md#a-cascade-along-total-dependence))*
- **Does not begin** (5 laws). The stock's level, once below m, is below m after each of the next n steps: it does not return. *If:* at each step the law uses, every formation taking part that gives to c requires c there at a need of at least m; whatever takes part and gives to the condition c across the step is supported there, at each step the law names; the flow balances on each condition of the family the law names at every step of the stretch the law names; the level of the condition c (or of the course x) at the step the law names (t, T, or s) is below m. *(enough for it; `Flow.stays_below_at`, [Loss of renewal for good](../atlas/families/a.md#loss-of-renewal-for-good))*
- **Where the line falls** (27 laws). From a start up to the top, the stock's level reaches nothing at some step exactly where the start is below H + y. *If:* giving falls short of the draw H at every level below y; giving meets the draw H at every level z from y with z + H at most hi; nothing gives from nothing; the regime's step keeps the band up to hi: from every level up to hi it leads to a level up to hi; and 3 more. *(exactly where; `RegimeMargin.ends_iff_below`, [The point of no return of a regime](../atlas/families/a.md#margin-of-a-regime))*
- **Unmoved by**. Up to step T, the course where both give at every step and the course where neither gives keep every level the same. *If:* in the first run both formations are active at every step before the bound; in the first run both formations intend to give at every step; in the second run neither formation intends to give at any step; the two runs start from the same standings; and 3 more. *(enough for it; `PairFlow.WhileStanding.runs_agree_until`, [What decides giving against keeping on a flow](../atlas/families/e.md#what-decides-giving-against-keeping-on-a-flow))*
- **More of one gives no less of another** (3 laws). A larger recent giving up to the top has a threshold no higher. *If:* the adjustment A rises with what is left and with the recent giving; the adjusted step keeps the band up to hi; of two recent givings compared, the first is at most the second; the adjusted run starts from a recent giving at most hi, the top of the band. *(enough for it; `RegimeMargin.Adjusted.threshold_falls`, [One law of exact thresholds, and the threshold in the plane of level and recent giving](../atlas/families/a.md#threshold-in-the-state-plane))*
- **Cannot** (6 laws). It cannot be that from that step on no configuration of the stocks is had again after a change; no step is named. *If:* every change of a level is exactly what is taken from it and given to it; across the step from t, every formation taking part gives the family cs (the whole: the family with the conditions beyond it, or a family containing the family) no more than it …; the family's configuration changes at arbitrarily late steps. *(enough for it; `Flow.Balances.unending_change_revisits`, [Lossless exchange can continue and return](../atlas/families/f.md#lossless-exchange-continues-and-returns))*
- **Read backward** (5 laws). At a step where the dependent is active, the embodied stock it needs at a positive need is active too. *If:* a relatum is active only where the levels meet everything it then requires; the relatum y stands as a condition exactly while it is active: at every step, y is active exactly where its level is positive; the formation g requires the condition c at the steps the law names (one step, or every step); the formation's need of the condition at the step the law names is positive (the start, in the optimum laws); and 1 more. *(enough for it; `Web.Embodied.active_of_bearing`, [Co-ending along dependence](../atlas/families/a.md#co-ending-along-dependence))*
- **The same as, in another model** (6 laws). Under the regime's own step the threshold is H + y, its point of no return, at every recent giving up to the top. *If:* the regime's giving rises with what is left; giving falls short of the draw H at every level below y; giving meets the draw H at every level z from y with z + H at most hi; the band's top reaches the point of no return; and 3 more. *(enough for it; `RegimeMargin.threshold_regime`, [One law of exact thresholds, and the threshold in the plane of level and recent giving](../atlas/families/a.md#threshold-in-the-state-plane))*
- **If something given were otherwise** (17 laws). The stock, starting at or above the need, stays at or above it at every step exactly where the draw is within the renewal. *If:* a course re-optimized at every step: each step balances and the levels after it are an optimum of the part's order among the outcomes open to it, the part acting within its …; at or above the need, exactly r is given at every step; the withdrawal is one constant at every step the law names; the start s is at or above the need m; and 9 more. *(exactly where; `Web.course_kept_iff`, [Re-optimizing at every step](../atlas/families/b.md#re-optimizing-above-a-renewal-ends-it))*

<a id="role-renewer"></a>
### what gives back

补给者. What gives to a stock, from inside or from beyond. 1 principal laws, from 1 dynamics.

- **Ends**. From some step at or after T0 on, the renewer (the sustaining formation) is inactive at every step. *If:* from step T0 on, the renewal and the focal contribution together fall short of the focal draw; the sustaining formation's need is positive; the focal formation's need is at most the sustaining formation's. *(enough for it; `SupportGated.overdraw_ends`, [Loss of renewal for good](../atlas/families/a.md#loss-of-renewal-for-good))*
- **No law here shows** what makes it begin, last or change.

<a id="role-drawers"></a>
### the drawers

取用者. What takes from a stock: one, the others, or all together. 4 principal laws, from 4 dynamics.

- **Ends** (2 laws). The other drawer is inactive at every step from T plus the stock's level at T on, for good. *If:* f takes all that is given to c across the step from t; the formation f is active at every step; the formation g is active only while it takes part and takes from c; from T on, the seeker is active at a step only where it was active at the step before; and 8 more. *(enough for it; `Flow.continuing_ends_taker`, [What taking all that is given excludes](../atlas/families/b.md#what-taking-all-excludes))*
- **Cannot** (2 laws). Not every member of the first n generations of takers is active at its generation's step; the law names no member and no step. *If:* nothing is given to the condition c across each of the n steps from T; each generation from T before the n-th is at least twice the one before; at each of the n steps from T, every active member of the generation takes part in the flow and takes from c; the level of c at T plus one is below 2^n; and 4 more. *(enough for it; `LineageRegimes.multiplying_takers_stop`, [Ending laws as regimes on a lineage](../atlas/families/a.md#ending-laws-as-regimes-on-a-lineage))*
- **No law here shows** what makes it begin, last or change.

<a id="role-dependent"></a>
### what depends on it

依者. What needs a stock at some level, whether or not it draws on it. 19 principal laws, from 13 dynamics.

- **Ends** (15 laws). At each step from T on, a dependent that then needs the stock at m or more is inactive. *If:* a relatum is active only where the levels meet everything it then requires; the level of the condition c is below m at every step from T; the formation g requires the condition c at the steps the law names (one step, or every step); the formation the law names (g, h or f) needs c at the steps the law names (one step, or every step) at a level of at least m. *(enough for it; `Flow.ends_below`, [Loss of renewal for good](../atlas/families/a.md#loss-of-renewal-for-good))*
- **Does not begin**. The dependent does not begin to be active across that step: it does not go from inactive to active. *If:* at t and at t + 1, g is active exactly where it is supported; every condition g requires at t it still requires at t + 1; g's need of every condition is the same at t and t + 1; every condition's level is the same after the step from t as before. *(enough for it; `Web.not_arises_of_unchanged`, [Unceasing arising needs renewal](../atlas/families/g.md#unceasing-generation-needs-renewal))*
- **Where the line falls**. Over any stretch of steps from S, the dependent is active at most as often as its reserve at S. *If:* the formation is unsupported at every step from the step named on; some reserve carries activity beyond support; and 2 more. *(enough for it; `Web.Carries.lasts`, [A reserve defers the end](../atlas/families/a.md#reserve-defers-ending))*
- **Cannot**. The dependent is not active at arbitrarily late steps; no last active step is named. *If:* the formation is unsupported at every step from the step named on; some reserve carries activity beyond support. *(enough for it; `Web.Carries.active_not_recurring`, [A reserve defers the end](../atlas/families/a.md#reserve-defers-ending))*
- **No law here shows** what makes it begin, last or change.
- **If something given were otherwise** (1 law). Each part alone forms at every step; under their joint draw every share of what forms is nothing from the budget step on. *If:* the pressure is within the initial renewal rate and never empty; at every step the pressure exceeds the initial renewal rate; the shared formation's share at each step is at most what forms under the joint pressure; a supplied wear law: pressure within the rate keeps it, pressure beyond a positive rate lowers it, and the rate never rises. *(enough for it; `RenewingFormation.jointly_exceeding_parts_end_shared_formation`, [Renewing and consuming formation](../atlas/families/h.md#renewing-consuming-formation))*

<a id="role-rule"></a>
### a rule

规则. What a choosing goes by: a selection, an order over outcomes, a quota, a score. 3 principal laws, from 3 dynamics.

- **Lasts** (2 laws). Along a course of the declared protocol with no adoption, the rule in force at its end is the rule at its start. *If:* no event of the course is an adoption; and 1 more. *(enough for it; `RuleHandoff.rule_inherited`, [What ungated steps keep; an empty pool stays empty](../atlas/families/a.md#what-a-gate-keeps))*
- **No law here shows** what makes it begin, change or end.
- **If something given were otherwise** (1 law). A one-step law restores mutual giving and answers a constant withholder exactly where it gives just where the pair's last steps agreed. *If:* the one-step law of a pair gives where both gave. *(exactly where; `WindowedWaiting.restores_and_answers_iff`, [A pair tolerates only within a window](../atlas/families/e.md#a-pair-tolerates-only-within-a-window))*

<a id="role-selected"></a>
### what it selects among

所选者. What a rule picks among: the carriers of what it favours and the rest, with the share of each. 15 principal laws, from 7 dynamics.

- **Lasts** (3 laws). From any step, the share is at no later step lower than it was at that step. *If:* the rule in force favours at every step of the course; selection under a favouring rule does not lower the share. *(enough for it; `RuleCapture.share_kept_along`, [A reading against the share does not ratchet](../atlas/families/c.md#a-reading-against-the-share-does-not-ratchet))*
- **Where the line falls** (9 laws). Across the stretch the shapers' share does not fall exactly where each other's offspring, multiplied over the steps, are at most each shaper's. *If:* each shaper leaves a + s + p offspring and each other a + c + p: a what each leaves without shaping, positive; s the part that comes back to the shapers alone; p the part that …; the start has shapers, for the course of the rule after shaping and of every rule built from it (the rule read by readers drawn from the selected, the rules read in time); and 3 more. *(exactly where; `RuleShaping.stretch_iff`, [The capacity to shape the rule, selected by what comes back to it](../atlas/families/c.md#shaping-the-rule-selected-by-what-comes-back))*
- **No law here shows** what makes it begin, change or end.
- **If something given were otherwise** (3 laws). The shapers' share falls strictly at every step of the run, the rule held with nothing coming back to them alone. *If:* each shaper leaves a + s + p offspring and each other a + c + p: a what each leaves without shaping, positive; s the part that comes back to the shapers alone; p the part that …; shaping costs the shapers something; the start has shapers, for the course of the rule after shaping and of every rule built from it (the rule read by readers drawn from the selected, the rules read in time); and 3 more. *(enough for it; `RuleShaping.nothing_back_falls`, [The capacity to shape the rule, selected by what comes back to it](../atlas/families/c.md#shaping-the-rule-selected-by-what-comes-back))*

<a id="role-readers"></a>
### its readers

读取者. What a rule or a reading is read through: a pool, a group, the couplings into it. 2 principal laws, from 2 dynamics.

- **Lasts**. After a supplied step a present reader is still present, whatever the level before the step. *If:* the reader's spent units are rebuilt from the level it reads; the set level is at least one; the reader is present: it has at least one unit; the reader wants at least one unit. *(enough for it; `ReaderRebuilding.«供则读者不绝»`, [The stock buys time where the rebuild draws on it](../atlas/families/h.md#the-stock-buys-time-where-the-rebuild-draws-on-it))*
- **Unmoved by**. At every step the reader stands in the course of the one act exactly when it stands in the course of the other. *If:* the two acts exchange alike, for each member of the part, with every condition coupled into a member of the group's coupling closure drawn through the two courses; h lies within the group's coupling closure drawn through both flows; the reader r couples into its own standing by level: obs r r; the law reads, for each formation outside the part, only what couples into that formation; and 3 more. *(enough for it; `reader_kept_alike`, [A selection read off the pool its own course gives registers no removal](../atlas/families/b.md#selection-read-off-its-own-survivors))*
- **No law here shows** what makes it begin, change or end.

<a id="role-reading"></a>
### a reading

读法. What something holds of what it meets: a view, a prediction, a rank, a code from senses to forms. 13 principal laws, from 10 dynamics.

- **Lasts** (4 laws). From the first step on the reading rests: the same candidates kept, the same act taken, the same value read at every step. *If:* at the start the formation chooses the start's act from the candidates listed, the world answers that act with the value sensed, and the world's move leaves it as it is; every listed candidate predicts, at the value sensed and the act chosen, the answer the world gives there; and 1 more. *(enough for it; `ReadingLoop.Loop.rests_of_unrefuted`, [What a course chosen through its model does not test](../atlas/families/d.md#what-a-course-chosen-through-its-model-does-not-test))*
- **Does not begin**. A reading taken from the view that is never false on closed states gives no answer at the settled course's view. *If:* on the domain, wherever the answer read from the evidence gives a value, that value is the target. *(enough for it; `Generative.NormativeActivity.sound_closed_answer_abstains`, [Adaptive closure: a reference changed outside what is retained is not resolved from the view](../atlas/families/d.md#adaptive-closure-cannot-resolve))*
- **Unmoved by** (2 laws). From any listing and valuation, filtering by what is shown then revaluing by an input gives the same state as the other order. *If:* decided where a law counts or names. *(enough for it; `ListingValuation.updates_commute`, [A reading informed and revalued along one law: the updates commute, the courses do not](../atlas/families/d.md#a-reading-informed-and-revalued))*
- **More of one gives no less of another**. Across every change of amounts, over the family the rises in position total the same as the falls. *(enough for it; `RelativePosition.change_balances`, [Position does not protect](../atlas/families/b.md#position-does-not-protect))*
- **Cannot** (2 laws). A count belief at the free-energy bound for weights a renaming moving every word fixes has no uniquely greatest word. *If:* the weights are unchanged by the renaming; the renaming moves every word: at the meaning m, or, in the free-energy laws, on the listed words; the weights have a positive total; the count belief meets the free-energy bound with equality for the weights over the listing; and 1 more. *(enough for it; `CountedCodes.minimizer_no_unique_greatest`, [A code held as counts, learned from what is heard](../atlas/families/c.md#a-code-held-as-counts))*
- **Read backward** (2 laws). A fixed point of the three-valued revision shows some sentence undecided. *If:* two-valued revision of the system has no fixed point; the system of sentences is closed at N; the three-valued assignment w is a fixed point of revision on the first N sentences. *(enough for it; `Undecided.undecided_of_moves`, [The liar's revision never rests with two values; with three, from all undecided, it rests undecided](../atlas/families/f.md#revision-with-an-undecided-value))*
- **No law here shows** what makes it begin, change or end.
- **If something given were otherwise** (1 law). From that step on, at every step and under every rule, every formation holds the imposed form at that sense. *If:* at step n every member of the group G holds at m the form the code c gives it; at step n every formation outside the group G holds at m the form c gives it as well; and 1 more. *(needed for it; `SharedCodes.outside_needed`, [A merged distinction returns only from a form held outside, or by coining](../atlas/families/g.md#merged-distinctions-stay-merged))*

<a id="anything-that-goes-on"></a>
## Anything that goes on

凡相续者. 106 principal laws name no role: they hold of every course, every process or every relation. 23 dynamics are made of such laws alone: [the list](DYNAMICS.md#anything-that-goes-on).

- **Begins** (5 laws). The courses of the first and the third configuration meet: at some steps they are at one configuration. *If:* the courses of two configurations under the determined law next meet: at some steps n and m they are at one configuration. *(enough for it; `Law.Meet.trans`, [Basins of a determined law, one cycle each](../atlas/families/a.md#basins-of-a-determined-law))*
- **Lasts** (27 laws). Everything that can be had from one configuration can be had from another exactly where the other leads back to the first. *(exactly where; `keeps_reach_iff_returns`, [Necessarily drawn exactly what does not return](../atlas/families/a.md#necessarily-drawn-is-not-returning))*
- **Changes** (7 laws). Some course from the start changes at arbitrarily late steps exactly where a reachable configuration steps to another that can reach it again. *If:* a list holds every configuration. *(exactly where; `Settling.keeps_changing_iff`, [A run round a loop keeps changing](../atlas/families/f.md#a-run-round-a-loop-keeps-changing))*
- **Ends** (10 laws). A configuration is drawn into some region the law never leaves exactly where its course never again is at it, for good. *(exactly where; `Law.drawn_iff_not_returns`, [Drawn exactly where it does not return](../atlas/families/a.md#attraction-is-not-returning))*
- **Does not begin** (3 laws). Nothing in the region goes out of it along the relation exactly where what is not outside the region is closed under the relation. *(exactly where; `«不出当且仅当不外者闭»`, [Not going out of a region](../atlas/families/a.md#not-going-out-of-a-region))*
- **Where the line falls** (2 laws). A level up to the bound has the fate exactly where it is below the length of the check's leading run of true. *If:* the fate P is down-closed in the level up to hi; the Boolean check is exact for the fate up to hi; and 1 more. *(exactly where; `RegimeMargin.leading_exact`, [One law of exact thresholds, and the threshold in the plane of level and recent giving](../atlas/families/a.md#threshold-in-the-state-plane))*
- **Unmoved by** (2 laws). At every number of steps, any observable's expectation from the image equals its expectation, read through the map, from the configuration. *If:* the weighted law commutes with σ: every weighted total over the successors of σ x is the total over the successors of x carried by σ. *(enough for it; `Weighted.Commutes.carried`, [What a commuting law keeps apart, and what a learner's symmetry fixes](../atlas/families/d.md#what-a-commuting-law-keeps-apart))*
- **Cannot** (19 laws). No step from there is a losing step: after every step from there, that the configuration can still be had cannot be refuted. *If:* the configuration x has a step after which s can still be had; the configuration x is not a juncture for s; the process takes a step from x by the move a to y, at a configuration the law names. *(enough for it; `Branching.keeps_before_juncture`, [Every loss passes a juncture](../atlas/families/a.md#every-loss-passes-a-juncture))*
- **Read backward** (10 laws). Not not: some course from the configuration to where it is lost takes a losing step at a juncture for it. *If:* the configuration s returns under the process P: some step from s leads to a configuration from which s can be reached; the list of acts as is a trace of the process P from s to t: Trace P s as t; from the configuration t, s cannot be reached again under the process P. *(enough for it; `Branching.loss_passes_juncture`, [Every loss passes a juncture](../atlas/families/a.md#every-loss-passes-a-juncture))*
- **The same as, in another model** (7 laws). That every line meeting the head law's premise at the activity class reaches an end holds exactly where excluded middle holds. *(exactly where; `Map.end_of_gone_iff_excluded_middle`, [Degeneration from a horizon](../atlas/families/a.md#degeneration-from-a-horizon))*
- **If something given were otherwise** (14 laws). A start lasts n steps within the guard, under every admissible disturbance, exactly where some ladder holds it at level n. *(exactly where; `Lasting.lasts_iff_ladder`, [Draining: below a drained level no history lasts](../atlas/families/a.md#market-finite-support-obstruction))*
